prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production animation sprite atlas for Animal vs Animal, preserving the creature identities and detailed 16/32-bit pixel-art style of the reference atlases. Idle; low stalking crouch; long low leaping stride with mouth open; backward braced reaction. Row4: gray ELEPHANT, two ivory tusks, broad ears, long trunk. Idle; lowered head with trunk curled; charging step with extended trunk; recoil with trunk raised. Keep trunk/tail attached and accurate anatomy.
